headline: Kyrgyzstan's banks lost 5.3 percent of assets — down to 1.4 trillion soms
summary: Total assets of Kyrgyzstan's commercial banks stood at 1.425 trillion soms at the end of September 2026, down 5.3% from August.
why: Commercial banks channel most household and business credit in Kyrgyzstan, so a shrinking asset base can signal tighter lending capacity in the local economy.
original_headline: Банки Кыргызстана потеряли 5,3 процента активов — до 1,4 триллиона сомов
